repos_data.description: A paging menu controller built from other view controllers placed inside a scroll view (like Spotify, Windows Phone, Instagram)
Paging indicator widgets compatible with the ViewPager from the Android Support Library and ActionBarSherlock.
Pager is the simplest and best way to implement sliding view controllers in Swift

repo_meta_data.description: A scroll pager that displays a list of tabs (segments) and manages paging between given views
